title: Erdős #10: Prime Plus Powers of 2 — Romanoff Density and Open Conjecture
description: Infrastructure for Erdős Problem #10: can every integer be expressed as a prime plus at most k powers of 2? Formalizes Romanoff's theorem (positive density of integers representable as p + 2^k), proves small-case verification infrastructure, and states the conjecture formally. Erdős believed no such constant k exists. 5 axioms for Romanoff density and sieve bounds. 34 theorems.
